issues.source_quote: Когда это кончится? - Сейчас заканчиваю. Я спрашиваю, когда кончатся ваши безответственные опыты
issues.translation_quote: when will this stop? - I'm almost done. I mean, when will your irresponsible experiments stop?
issues.justification: The pun on 'кончится/заканчиваю' is flattened; 'I'm almost done' does not answer the question in a way that makes the misunderstanding clear.

issues.source_quote: Но риск, как говорится...
issues.translation_quote: But no risk, no...
issues.justification: Adds a proverb fragment ('no risk, no reward') that is cut off; acceptable but the source is simply 'risk, as they say' — the truncation reads awkwardly and changes the phrase.

issues.source_quote: Не закрывайте рот!
issues.translation_quote: Keep your mouth open!
issues.justification: Mistranslation: the dentist's colleague/patient context means 'Don't close your mouth!' (i.e., to a patient), but the rendering is bizarre without context; also 'Антон Семенович, Вас!' context lost.

issues.source_quote: Нет, не знакомая, но безумно хочу познакомиться.
issues.translation_quote: No, we haven't met, but I'm dying to meet you.
issues.justification: Acceptable meaning, but the preceding 'Говорит одна артистка' becomes 'An actress speaking', losing the comic self-introduction; minor loss.

issues.source_quote: Вы свами разводами резко снижаете наши показатели.
issues.translation_quote: Your divorces are seriously hurting our statistics.
issues.justification: Soviet bureaucratic joke about building's 'показатели' (performance indicators) is rendered neutrally; the satire of bureaucratic language is weakened.

issues.source_quote: Тьфу на Вас!
issues.translation_quote: Oh, get lost!
issues.justification: Register and tone mismatch: 'Тьфу на Вас' is a mock-spitting rebuke, and 'Get lost' loses the quasi-archaic comic flavor, especially as it is repeated ('Тьфу на Вас еще раз').

issues.source_quote: Пиши далее!
issues.translation_quote: Keep writing!
issues.justification: Fine, but earlier 'К пренебесному селению... Преподобному игумну Козьме' is rendered 'To the most heavenly abode', losing the rhetorical archaic formula.

issues.source_quote: Ты куда звонить собрался? - В милицию! - Положь трубку!
issues.translation_quote: Put down the receiver! ... I'll crush you, you clown!
issues.justification: The wordplay on 'положь/клади/ложи' (the Tsar's incorrect non-standard imperative and the confusion 'Чего положь?') is lost; 'Put down what?' only partly conveys it, and no non-standard speech marker is kept. 'Задавлю, шляпа' is rendered 'clown', losing the insult.

issues.source_quote: Нет, нет, давайте не будем... Стоп, стоп!
issues.translation_quote: Stop, stop!
issues.justification: Minor context; but 'Вот что крест животворящий делает!' becomes 'Behold the power of the life-giving cross!' which is acceptable.

issues.source_quote: Что случилось? - Куда стенка девалась?
issues.translation_quote: Half the apartment's gone! - Nothing's happened!
issues.justification: Speaker attribution scrambled ('See what I've invented?' etc.), making who says what unclear.

issues.source_quote: Я - артист больших и малых академических театров!
issues.translation_quote: I'm an actor of major and minor academic theaters!
issues.justification: The joke on 'больших и малых' (Bolshoi and Maly theaters) is lost; 'major and minor' makes no sense to an English audience.

issues.source_quote: На мне узоров нету и цветы не растут.
issues.translation_quote: I don't have flowers growing on me.
issues.justification: The idiom (no patterns on me, no flowers growing) is truncated, losing the folk-saying humor.

issues.source_quote: Меня терзают смутные сомнения.
issues.translation_quote: I'm beginning to have vague suspicions.
issues.justification: This is a famous catchphrase with a parodic literary register (echoing 'Терзают смутные сомненья'); it is rendered as flat prose and later inconsistently as 'Vague doubts haunt me once again'.

issues.source_quote: Это - первый раз в моей жизни. Ему сообщают, что жена от него уходит, а он: "так-так-так".
issues.translation_quote: He's told his wife is leaving him, and all he says is, "I see, I see."
issues.justification: Grammatical error ('He's told his wife' should be 'He's told that his wife'), and 'I see' loses the clipped 'так-так-так' sound.

issues.source_quote: Тоже мне, Тарапунька и Штепсель нашелся.
issues.translation_quote: He thinks he's a comedian.
issues.justification: Culturally specific reference (famous Soviet comic duo) is entirely lost without any equivalent.

issues.source_quote: Тамбовский волк тебе боярин!
issues.translation_quote: I'm no boyar, you fool!
issues.justification: The idiom 'Tambov wolf is your boyar' is a Russian insult/joke; the translation omits the idiom and changes speaker attribution.

issues.source_quote: Если бы Вы были моей женой, я бы повесился!
issues.translation_quote: If you were my wife, I'd hang myself!
issues.justification: Fine; but the joke of 'Будь я Вашей женой' preceded by 'Хам!' rendered 'Brute!' is acceptable. No issue.

issues.source_quote: Три магнитофона, 3 кинокамеры, 3 портсигара отечественных
issues.translation_quote: Three tape recorders, three movie cameras, Three tape recorders, three movie cameras, three cigarette cases, domestic…
issues.justification: Duplicated text and ellipses in the translation produce a garbled, unnatural subtitle.

issues.source_quote: Выходит, два. - И оба Бунши? Оба! И тебя вылечат!
issues.translation_quote: Both! and they’ll cure you too… and they’ll cure me… They'll cure me too!
issues.justification: Garbled, repeated and inconsistent fragments with stray ellipses and capitalization.

issues.source_quote: Здравствуйте, царь! Очень приятно!
issues.translation_quote: Hello, I’m the Tsar, very pleased to meet you. The Tsar, very pleased. Tsar, very pleased. Hello, the Tsar.
issues.justification: Source is a confused string of greetings; the translation adds 'I'm the Tsar' and is awkward and inconsistent.

issues.source_quote: Шайбу, шайбу...
issues.translation_quote: Score a goal! Score a goal!
issues.justification: The hockey chant is a topical cultural joke applied to the crowd shouting 'Tsar'; 'Score a goal' is a weak equivalent ('Puck, puck').

issues.source_quote: Тут чего он там забыл? - Лови! Нет, это наоборот, Жорж
issues.translation_quote: Exactly, and I'm Georges.
issues.justification: The joke 'Ванька-разбойник ... а я наоборот, Жорж' is unclear; 'Ivan the Terrible' / 'Miloslavsky' namesake joke is blurred.

issues.source_quote: Оставь меня, старушка, я в печали.
issues.translation_quote: Leave me, old woman, I am in sorrow.
issues.justification: The comic archaic register is acceptable but 'I am in sorrow' is stiff; also 'старушка' (a cheeky diminutive) becomes harsh 'old woman'.

issues.source_quote: Вот они, как покойники стреляют!?
issues.translation_quote: See that? The dead men are shooting!
issues.justification: Acceptable; but 'Они давным-давно покойники' rendered 'died centuries ago' adds information.

issues.source_quote: Бунша
issues.translation_quote: Bunsha
issues.justification: Fine; but 'Бунша' is rendered inconsistently with 'Ivan the Terrible' rank titles (Tsar/Tsarina vs. earlier 'Царица' Margarita/Marfa/Marya names).

issues.source_quote: Что Вы, что Вы! Вам очень идет.
issues.translation_quote: Oh, no! It suits you.
issues.justification: 'Что Вы' is a polite deflection, here 'Oh no!' reads as alarm.

issues.source_quote: Это сон какой-то!
issues.translation_quote: This is like a dream!
issues.justification: Acceptable; however 'Заморская икра... Баклажанная!' rendered 'Overseas spread… eggplant!' loses the joke that eggplant caviar is the 'overseas' caviar.

issues.source_quote: Три раза я развелась. Ну да, три. Зюзина я не считаю.
issues.translation_quote: I've been divorced three times. Yes, three. I don't count Zyuzin.
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Не выписывай
issues.translation_quote: Just don't remove me from the tenancy records yet.
issues.justification: Bureaucratic 'выписывать' (deregister from residence) rendered with unfamiliar 'tenancy records'; 'propiska' concept unclear.

issues.source_quote: Что у меня произошло с женой? ... Я прошу Вас повременить с разводом до конца квартала.
issues.translation_quote: What business is it of yours...
issues.justification: Acceptable.

issues.source_quote: Профессион де фуа!
issues.translation_quote: "Professional duty"!
issues.justification: The pretentious French mispronunciation ('profession de foi') is lost, flattening the joke.

issues.source_quote: Боже, какой типаж! ... Бунше
issues.translation_quote: He looks like our Bunsha!
issues.justification: Acceptable.
